title: Relationship breakdown and capital gains tax

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Find out if you can defer, or 'roll over', CGT on assets that transfer to you in a divorce.

Check that you have a court order or formal agreement that qualifies for the relationship breakdown CGT rollover.

Work out your CGT on rollover assets, including assets transferred from other entities.

If a property was the home of you or your spouse, check if it is exempt from CGT.
